Subject: Data deletion attestation request & sample artifacts

Hi Jordan,

We're kicking off the Nordline SOC2 fieldwork focused on retention and deletion controls. As part of the audit we need a deletion attestation for tenant data for our EU tenants, plus sample artifacts showing the deletion process for one tenant deletion executed in the last 90 days. Specifically we need: 

- A signed attestation (simple one-paragraph statement is fine) confirming Redwood performed a complete tenant deletion for tenant ID NL-8893 and scope of what was removed.
- A small set of artifacts (csv/manifest, lifecycle policy, DB TTL logs, KMS rotation or key usage evidence) demonstrating the end-to-end flow and chain-of-custody for that deletion.
- Timeline and owners for the deletion workflow (who initiated, who approved, timestamps).

We appreciate redactions for any PII but need enough context to validate the controls. Ideally we can get those items by EOD Monday (26 Jul) to include in the evidence bucket. If that's not possible, please advise a realistic ETA.

Thanks,
Anika
